skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting the numerators of fractions with identical denominators.

skills.name: Finding Common Denominator
skills.definition: Finding the least common multiple of unlike denominators and converting fractions to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Whole Number Operations
skills.definition: Separating and subtracting the whole number components of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Regrouping / Borrowing
skills.definition: Borrowing one or more units from the whole number part and converting it to a fraction to resolve a negative fraction difference.

skills.name: Fraction Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing a fraction to its lowest terms.
